title: Taxus chinensis (Pilg.) Rehder fruit attenuates aging behaviors and neuroinflammation by inhibiting microglia activation via TLR4/NF-kappaB/NLRP3 pathway.
authors: Meimei, Chen; Fei, Zhang; Wen, Xu; Huangwei, Lei; Zhenqiang, Hong; Rongjun, Yu; Qiang, Zhao; Qiuyang, Li; Xiaozhen, Liu; Yuan, Yang; Zhaoyang, Yang; Candong, Li
one_liner_zh: 研究红豆杉果实提取物通过TLR4/NF-kB/NLRP3通路抑制小胶质细胞活化发挥抗衰老和抗神经炎症作用，核心为植物药理学与炎症通路，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，仅含分子对接但对象非核酸-蛋白体系。
abstract: ETHNOPHARMACOLOGICAL RELEVANCE: As one of the important by-products of Taxus chinensis (Pilg.) Rehder, its fruit (TCF) has a sweet taste, which is commonly used in folklore to make health care wine reputed for enhancing immune function and promoting anti-aging effects, especially popular in the longevity villages of China for a long history. Evidences had showed that Taxus chinensis fruit contained polysaccharides, flavonoids, amino acids and terpenoids, which all were free of toxic compounds, but its medicinal value has not been fully recognized. Our previous studies have found that TCF extract may reverse many biological events, including oxidative stress, inflammatory response, neuronal apoptosis, etc. by in silico methods, suggesting potential avenues for future pharmaceutical exploration in aging and age-related diseases. AIM OF THE STUDY: Yet, the anti-aging properties of TCF have not been specifically studied, this study aims to fill this gap by investigating the effects of TCF extract (TCFE) in an aging mouse model, particularly focusing on its role in inhibiting microglial activation and elucidating its underlying anti-aging mechanisms. MATERIALS AND METHODS: An aging mouse model was induced using D-galactose, with interventions involving high, medium, and low doses of TCFE compared to a positive control (2 mg/kg rapamycin combined with 100 mg/kg metformin). The methodology involved evaluating behavioral changes, serum oxidative and antioxidative markers, hypothalamic beta-galactosidase activity, expression of the aging-related protein P63, serum inflammatory factors, and the TLR4/NF-kappaB/NLRP3 inflammatory pathway in hypothalamic tissues. Additionally, to strengthen our in vivo findings, we conducted in vitro experiments on LPS-stimulated BV2 microglial cells. Finally, UPLC-MS/MS for precise component analysis using compound standards, coupled with molecular docking analyses, were employed to discern and elucidate the anti-inflammatory mechanisms of TCF. RESULTS: In vivo results revealed TCFE significantly ameliorated behavioral deficits, reduced oxidative stress markers (MDA) and pro-inflammatory cytokines (IL1-beta, IL-6, IFNg, TNFalpha, IL-17), and increased in antioxidants (SOD, T-AOC) and anti-inflammatory factors (IL-10). TCFE also reduced hypothalamic senescence, improved cellular integrity, lowered p63, and inhibited microglia activation and inflammatory pathways (TLR4, NFKB, NLRP3). The overall effect of TCFE was better than that of the positive drug group (rapamycin combined with metformin). In vitro results further revealed that TCFE markedly decreased IL1-beta, NFKB, and TLR4 levels in BV2 microglial cells, showing comparable efficacy to a TLR4 classic positive inhibitor C34, supporting its anti-inflammatory role. Through UPLC-MS/MS analysis coupled with compound standards, we identified ten bioactive compounds, including gallocatechin, epigallocatechin, catechin, procyanidin B2, kaempferol, quercetin, rutin, naringin, apigenin, ginkgetin. All these compounds showed strong binding affinity to TLR4, notably procyanidin B2 and rutin, potentially through hydrogen bonds, aromatic cation-pi interactions, and hydrophobic interactions, suggesting a molecular basis for their anti-inflammatory action. CONCLUSION: TCFE showed strong anti-aging effects by inhibiting microglia activation and lessening oxidative stress and modulating inflammatory pathways. This research supports TCF's use in anti-aging and sets a base for future drug development in the realms of neuroinflammation and aging.
abstract_zh: 民族药理学相关性：作为红豆杉（Taxus chinensis (Pilg.) Rehder）的重要副产物之一，其果实（TCF）味甘，在民间常被用于制作保健酒，享有增强免疫功能和促进抗衰老作用的声誉，尤其在中国长寿村有着悠久的应用历史。已有证据表明，红豆杉果实含有多糖、黄酮类、氨基酸和萜类化合物，这些成分均无毒性化合物，但其药用价值尚未得到充分认识。我们前期的研究发现，通过计算机模拟方法，TCF提取物可能逆转多种生物学事件，包括氧化应激、炎症反应、神经元凋亡等，这为未来在衰老及年龄相关疾病领域的药物开发提供了潜在途径。研究目的：然而，TCF的抗衰老特性尚未被专门研究，本研究旨在通过探讨TCF提取物（TCFE）在衰老小鼠模型中的作用来填补这一空白，特别关注其抑制小胶质细胞活化的作用，并阐明其潜在的抗衰老机制。材料与方法：采用D-半乳糖诱导衰老小鼠模型，干预措施包括高、中、低剂量的TCFE，并与阳性对照（2 mg/kg雷帕霉素联合100 mg/kg二甲双胍）进行比较。方法学涉及评估行为变化、血清氧化和抗氧化标志物、下丘脑β-半乳糖苷酶活性、衰老相关蛋白P63的表达、血清炎症因子，以及下丘脑组织中的TLR4/NF-kappaB/NLRP3炎症通路。此外，为加强体内研究结果，我们对LPS刺激的BV2小胶质细胞进行了体外实验。最后，采用UPLC-MS/MS结合化合物标准品进行精确成分分析，并辅以分子对接分析，以识别和阐明TCF的抗炎机制。结果：体内结果显示，TCFE显著改善了行为缺陷，降低了氧化应激标志物（MDA）和促炎细胞因子（IL1-beta、IL-6、IFNg、TNFalpha、IL-17）的水平，并增加了抗氧化剂（SOD、T-AOC）和抗炎因子（IL-10）的水平。TCFE还减少了下丘脑衰老，改善了细胞完整性，降低了p63水平，并抑制了小胶质细胞活化和炎症通路（TLR4、NFKB、NLRP3）。TCFE的总体效果优于阳性药物组（雷帕霉素联合二甲双胍）。体外结果进一步表明，TCFE显著降低了BV2小胶质细胞中IL1-beta、NFKB和TLR4的水平，显示出与TLR4经典阳性抑制剂C34相当的功效，支持了其抗炎作用。通过UPLC-MS/MS分析结合化合物标准品，我们鉴定出十种生物活性化合物，包括没食子儿茶素、表没食子儿茶素、儿茶素、原花青素B2、山奈酚、槲皮素、芦丁、柚皮苷、芹菜素、银杏双黄酮。所有这些化合物均显示出与TLR4的强结合亲和力，尤其是原花青素B2和芦丁，可能通过氢键、芳香族阳离子-π相互作用和疏水相互作用实现，这为其抗炎作用提供了分子基础。结论：TCFE通过抑制小胶质细胞活化、减轻氧化应激和调节炎症通路，表现出强大的抗衰老效果。本研究支持TCF在抗衰老中的应用，并为未来在神经炎症和衰老领域的药物开发奠定了基础。
